# Feature request

> Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](feature_request.vi.md)

## Problem to solve

What user or operator problem would this improvement solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior or interface change.

## Alternatives considered

What simpler workaround or existing path did you consider?

## Runtime or qualification impact

Would this change CPU/CUDA profiles, worker topology, API/security behavior, model provenance, Kaggle demo behavior, Docker portability, or public claims? Explain any requalification requirement.

## Evidence

Add benchmark data, API examples, reproduction evidence, or operational constraints when relevant.
